semantic_checks: expires_window 'Истекает в течение {duration}': 'в течение' governs the genitive, which is exactly the case the shared bare duration_* branches produce (one минуты/часа, few/many минут/часов, other минуты/часа; 'менее минуты'). Probe renders every reachable duration (under a minute; minutes 1..89; hours 2..200) and every branch is genitive-correct: 'в течение 1 минуты', '2 минут', '21 минуты', '2 часов', '21 часа', '24 часов', 'менее минуты'. Meaning: minutes are ceil-rounded (approvalAnswerWindowLabel), so the record expires within the stated span; 'в течение' is accurate, not a softening. Same frame as the unchanged answer_window 'Ответьте в течение {duration}', so both outer messages share the duration grammatically (the new duration_* context requirement). Names the card, not permission lifetime.
R5A-RU-01 / R5B-1 (MAJOR, accusative 'через' + genitive durations) verified fixed: no branch renders '*через 1 минуты' / '*через 2 часов' any more.
